svg.title: ai-remote demo. An AI agent reads the UI tree of a remote Windows PC and clicks Export PDF by its element reference. Before a shell command that deletes files it stops, and you approve it once. When it heads for Share, you take over, fix one figure, and hand back; the agent then shares the updated report. Every step is written to the audit log.

g.text: Ran after your approval, 37 files removed
Shared the updated report with Finance

svg.text: Revenue and usage, July to September

g.text: Shared the updated report with Finance
It deletes files, so it waits for you.

The agent stopped before a shell command. Nothing runs until you decide.
The agent is paused and can't act until you hand back.
